meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub 的 PR 和 Issue 评论同步为聊天会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天中跟进 GitHub 上的代码审查和问题讨论
copy.tagline_en: Sync GitHub PR and issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to follow GitHub code reviews and issue discussions in chat

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可接入 GitHub:在指定的 pull request 和 issue 评论串里,收到 @机器人账号 的提及后就以该账号回复,并继续跟进后续评论。
howto.when: 当有人在已配置仓库的 PR 或 issue 评论中 @机器人账号 时触发;首次提及后该评论串会被订阅,后续评论也会响应。

say.text: 帮我给仓库 acme/backend 接入 GitHub 频道
say.note: Claude 会先问仓库是私有还是公开。

say.text: 用 strict 模式把 GitHub 接到专门的 agent 组
say.note: Claude 会创建消息组并添加成员。

say.text: 帮我设置 GitHub 机器人账号的凭据
say.note: Claude 会逐个询问所需的三个值。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can integrate with GitHub: on configured repos, it participates in pull request and issue comment threads. When @-mentioned, it replies as the bot account and then keeps responding to follow-up comments in that thread.
howto.when_en: Triggered when someone @-mentions the bot account in a PR or issue comment on a configured repo; after the first mention, the thread is subscribed and all subsequent comments are answered.

say_en.text: Add GitHub channel for repo acme/backend.
say_en.note: Asks whether the repo is private or public.

say_en.text: Connect GitHub to a dedicated agent group in strict mode.
say_en.note: Creates messaging group and adds members.

say_en.text: Set up credentials for the GitHub bot account.
say_en.note: Prompts for the three required values.
